subject: TURN directive
notes: kb/Work/PB595.md - LANDED. A >>TURN written lexically anywhere within an exception-checking (Format-3) PERFORM draws COBOL2187, a suppressible conformance warning quoting SR5 and naming the clause; the program still compiles and still runs, which is owner decision D20 (2026-07-19: FLAT BAN - imperative-statement-1 included - SUPPRESSIBLE WARNING, since ISO 4.2.2 requires for a syntax-rule violation only an optionally-invoked compile-time warning mechanism). A compiler directive is removed by the preprocessor and is in no parse tree, so containment is decided over POSITIONS: DirectiveSiteProcessor records each position-ruled directive's site on the FINAL text, the one frame in which a directive line and a parser token line are the same number, and the binder tests it against the PERFORM's own [Start.Line, Stop.Line] span. Editions: Format 3 is a 2023 introduction (Annex E.3.3 item 36), so the rule has no edition below it; the below-2023 gate is witnessed by conformance:cases/14.9.28-PERFORM/pb441-f3-perform-below-2023.
